info.title: EFMIS API
info.description: Ethiopian Fertilizer Supply Chain Management Information System — Demand Forecasting & Planning, Quota Allocation and Integration Framework (Requirements Specification, Aug 2026)

password.description: Initial password. Omit to generate a temporary one (returned once).

pin.description: E-signature PIN (4–8 digits) for users who sign documents

mustChangePassword.description: Force a password change at first sign-in

active.description: Deprecated: use /deactivate and /reactivate (kept for older clients)

temporaryPassword.description: Temporary password; omit to generate one (returned once)

baseRole.description: System role whose data scope applies

permissions.description: Full permission set (replaces the current one)

ticket.description: JWT accepted only by the realtime socket handshake (auth.token)

expiresAt.description: ISO time after which the ticket can no longer open a connection

unitId.description: Unit the alert concerns (default: the reporter's own unit; national roles may omit it)

ancestors.description: From the country down to the parent (breadcrumb)

isCurrent.description: The season new records default to

entityType.description: Record type, or the unit type for per-unit-and-season cases

level.description: Type of the unit that must act next

version.description: Send back as expectedVersion to detect concurrent changes

source.description: LEGACY = approval_actions recorded before the workflow engine

available.description: Actions the current user may take now

expectedVersion.description: Version the user saw; 409 when the case changed since

version.description: Optimistic concurrency: the version last read by the client

unitId.description: Kebele id (woreda officer) or woreda id (zone officer)

justification.example: Flooding in lowland area, reduce demand

approvedQtl.description: Approved quintals per fertilizer type (defaults to min(requested, recommended))

reason.example: Land certificate does not match the holder

farmerIds.description: Max 100; omitted = all pending in your kebele

justification.description: Required when usable stock changes by more than 10%

decision.description: Defaults to CONSENSUS_REACHED / NO_CONSENSUS from the tally

comments.example: Regional breakdown for Somali needs revision

justification.description: Required when deviating >10% from the recommendation

providerDeviceId.description: Device unique id as known by the GPS platform (Traccar uniqueId)

force.description: ADMIN only: unpair even while the truck is on a trip

reason.description: Reason recorded in the audit trail

reference.description: ECAE certificate of conformity / lab report no.

onHandDelta.description: ADJUSTMENT only: signed change of on-hand stock (MT)

lotNumber.description: Lot / QR batch. RECEIPT/RETURN/positive ADJUSTMENT: lot to add to (generated when omitted). DAMAGE/TRANSFER/negative ADJUSTMENT: lot to take from (first-expiry-first-out when omitted)

qcStatus.description: RECEIPT: PENDING keeps the lot unusable until quality control passes it (default PASSED)

input.description: Simulator mode: one entry per request

message.example: What is the net import requirement?

userId.description: Link (string) or unlink (null) a DRIVER login account

geometry.description: Polyline [[lat, lng], ...]; computed through the routing provider when omitted

recompute.description: Recompute geometry/distance/duration through the routing provider

sequence.description: Order on the route (defaults to last + 1)

geofenceId.description: Existing geofence; otherwise lat/lng (+radiusM) creates a CHECKPOINT circle geofence

minConsecutivePoints.description: Hysteresis: agreeing positions required to confirm a transition

waybillNumber.description: Transporter waybill number (legal transport document); issued automatically at dispatch when empty

reserveStock.description: Reserve stock at origin (default true when productId is given)

waybillNumber.description: Transporter waybill number (legal transport document); issued automatically at dispatch when empty

reserveStock.description: Reserve stock when no reservation exists yet

shipmentIds.description: Shipments (PLANNED, same origin warehouse); order = stop sequence

driverAcknowledged.description: Driver acknowledges trip details, cargo and route

clientScanId.description: Client-generated id; resending the same id returns the stored scan (offline scanners)

scannedAt.description: Device time of the scan (ISO 8601); default now

severity.description: Default by type: theft/diversion/robbery/tampering CRITICAL, accident HIGH, otherwise MEDIUM

resolution.example: Cargo recovered by Federal Police; 0.4 MT lost; driver cleared
